blocks.lede: A page and its media in one folder, published as a unit. Asset paths are bare file names, so nothing has to be rewritten when the folder moves.

blocks.markdown:
## How the folder is published

The page becomes `/post_i.html`. Everything beside it — images, audio, anything else — is copied to `/post_i/`, and every reference in this document is written out against that folder by the build, so a folder that has to take a suffix still finds its pictures.

The slug comes from the folder name, and shares one namespace with `input_markdown/` and `input_custom_html/`. Two inputs cannot claim the same URL — the build warns and adds a suffix.

This document is `post_i.json`. It is what the page builder reads and writes, and it is what the build renders. There is no HTML file in this folder.
